decks.notes: The deck revolves around using combo pieces like Mystic Forge, Voltaic Key, and Paradox Engine to generate an overwhelming amount of mana and card advantage. The goal is to assemble the powerful combo pieces quickly with cards like Mox Opal and Grim Monolith, allowing you to cast game-ending threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator adds versatility by being able to shut down opposing strategies or tutor for key artifacts like The One Ring. The main focus is on mana acceleration and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Mystic Forge and Urza's Saga to set up a combo that can generate infinite mana and draw the entire deck. With the help of cards like Defense Grid and City of Traitors, the deck aims to assemble key pieces quickly and efficiently to ultimately win the game with a Walking Ballista or other finisher. The inclusion of cards like Mesmeric Orb and Echo of Eons also helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure the combo can be successfully executed.

The main concept of this deck revolves around the "Bomberman" combo, which combines Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana. This combo is supported by cards such as Lotus Petal and defense Grid to ensure its success. The deck also includes Gyruda, Doom of Depths as a companion to bring additional value and disruption to the game. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly while utilizing control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Ingenious Smith to protect and enhance it. Additionally, the inclusion of The One Ring and Boromir, Gondor's Hope adds a thematic element to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate mana and control the game through disruption and card advantage. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient artifact creatures and powerful spells while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void. Emry, Lurker of the Loch serves as a powerful engine to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Urza's Saga provides additional artifact support. The deck's aggressive nature combined with its artifact synergies make it a formidable opponent in a Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle to generate massive amounts of mana in order to ramp quickly into powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Grist, the Hunger Tide. It also includes various toolbox creatures like Collector Ouphe and Endurance to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck utilizes green mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Elvish Reclaimer to help ramp and fix mana while also playing disruptive spells like Snuff Out. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game through efficient creature ramp and disruptive spells while overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out, and maintain card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm. With a mix of disruption, aggression, and card advantage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to efficiently and quickly set up a winning situation using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Doomsday, and Lotus Petal. By utilizing a combination of card draw and mana acceleration spells like Brainstorm, Dark Ritual, and Cabal Ritual, the deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces to win the game in a single turn. With an emphasis on controlling the game through Force of Will and disruption spells like Daze and Thoughtseize, the deck ultimately aims to win by using Thassa's Oracle alongside Doomsday to stack the top of the library for victory.

The deck focuses on using Cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to quickly deploy threats onto the battlefield. By utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, along with disruptive cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while also maintaining control of the game. Misty Rainforest, Taiga, and other lands provide mana fixing and acceleration to ensure the deck can consistently cast its spells and maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through efficient removal and disruption, while utilizing Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for powerful equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte. The deck also aims to protect its threats with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, and leverage cards like True-Name Nemesis and Teferi, Time Raveler to stay ahead on board. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Back to Basics and Prismatic Ending allows the deck to handle a wide range of threats and strategies in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Serra's Emissary into the graveyard and then reanimating them onto the battlefield. It has a heavy emphasis on discarding and sacrificing creatures to enable fast and explosive combos. With cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, the deck aims to fill the graveyard as quickly as possible to enable game-winning plays with cards like Reanimate and Exhume. The deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures before they have a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Archon of Emeria. The deck aims to use aggressive creatures like Solitude and Simian Spirit Guide to put pressure on the opponent, while also having access to powerful spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Touch the Spirit Realm for additional advantage. The deck is designed to win the game quickly and efficiently through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Opposition Agent, while also being able to exile cards from the opponent's graveyard with Rest in Peace and Leyline of the Void. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while using combos like Helm of Obedience and Leyline of the Void to win the game. The deck is optimized for a mono black strategy in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using land cards strategically to control the game, while also utilizing creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith are key in searching for key pieces like Dark Depths and Knight of the Reliquary. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong mana base, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and ultimately win through powerful land combinations like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage.

The main concept of this Legacy Combo-Dredge deck is to utilize cards like Cephalid Coliseum, Careful Study, and Breakthrough to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Grave-Troll, and Golgari Thug. By dredging these cards, players can trigger abilities that allow them to bring back powerful creatures like Ashen Rider or Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. Cards like Bridge from Below and Narcomoeba provide additional value by creating tokens and allowing for explosive plays. The deck focuses on graveyard synergy and utilizing the graveyard as a resource to overwhelm opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board by using efficient removal spells like Snuff Out and Fatal Push, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Leovold, Emissary of Trest. Additionally, the deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard and reanimate powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will and Daze also ensures that the opponent's spells can be countered, giving the deck a strong tempo advantage in the midrange matchups.

The main concept of this Legacy Combo Painter deck is to assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to tutor for combo pieces, as well as red disruption spells like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to protect the combo. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate the combo. Additionally, it includes utility cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Lightning Bolt for additional disruption and removal.
